/* PrdMngSQL.selectPrdMngList */ SELECT A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", A.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", A.PRD_STAT_CD AS "prdStatCd", CASE A.PRD_STAT_CD WHEN '30' THEN '판매중' WHEN '40' THEN '일시품절' WHEN '50' THEN '예약판매' WHEN '90' THEN '판매종료' ELSE '기타' END AS "prdStatNm", B.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", A.STOCK_QTY AS "stockQty", D.CAT_NM AS "lCatNm", A.REG_DT AS "regDt" FROM TB_PRD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_PRC B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CAT_MNG D ON A.L_CAT_CD = D.CAT_CD
ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{limitStart}

/* PrdMngSQL.selectPrdMngDtl */ SELECT A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", A.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", A.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", A.PRD_STAT_CD AS "prdStatCd", A.DELV_TP_CD AS "delvTpCd", A.L_CAT_CD AS "lCatCd", A.M_CAT_CD AS "mCatCd", A.S_CAT_CD AS "sCatCd", A.STOCK_QTY AS "stockQty", B.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", B.CARD_DISC_PRC AS "cardDiscPrc", B.CASH_DISC_PRC AS "cashDiscPrc", C.IMG_PATH AS "imgPath", C.IMG_NAME AS "imgName" FROM TB_PRD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_PRC B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG C ON A.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD AND C.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND C.SORT_SEQ = 1 WHERE A.PRD_CD = #{prdCd}
/* PrdMngSQL.selectCategoryByLevel */ SELECT CAT_CD AS "catCd", CAT_NM AS "catNm" FROM TB_CAT_MNG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND CAT_LVL = #{catLvl} ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
/* PrdMngSQL.selectSubCategoryList */ SELECT CAT_CD AS "catCd", CAT_NM AS "catNm" FROM TB_CAT_MNG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND UP_CAT_CD = #{upCatCd} ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

/* PrdMngSQL.selectPrdDtlImgList */ SELECT IMG_NO AS "imgNo", IMG_PATH AS "imgPath", IMG_NAME AS "imgName", SORT_SEQ AS "sortSeq" FROM TB_PRD_IMG WHERE PRD_CD = #{prdCd} AND IMG_TP_CD = '20' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
mapper.update: /* PrdMngSQL.updatePrdMst */ UPDATE TB_PRD_MST SET PRD_NM = #{prdNm}, SMPL_DESC = #{smplDesc}, PRD_STAT_CD = #{prdStatCd}, DELV_TP_CD = #{delvTpCd}, L_CAT_CD = #{lCatCd}, M_CAT_CD = #{mCatCd}, S_CAT_CD = #{sCatCd}, STOCK_QTY = #{stockQty}, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PRD_CD = #{prdCd}
